model_details.name: GeoDemand LightGBM Customer Count Forecaster
model_details.architecture: LightGBM Gradient Boosted Trees with Quantile Calibration Heads (P10/P90)

intended_use.primary_task: Next-hour expected customer footfall forecasting for mobile street vendors
intended_use.intended_users: Mobile vendors, municipal routing algorithms, inventory dispatch systems
intended_use.out_of_scope: Long-term seasonal macro planning, revenue speculation, direct price fixing

factors.demographic_groups: Vendor categories (Food, Chai, Fruits/Veg, Apparel, Repair)
factors.environmental_factors: Temperature, rainfall, humidity, wind speed, solar radiation
factors.temporal_factors: Diurnal hour rhythms, day of week, seasonal monsoon shifts, public holidays

ethical_considerations.fairness: Verified zero temporal leakage; uniform error dispersion across vendor categories
ethical_considerations.privacy: Zero PII stored or processed; all location coordinates mapped via anonymized H3 cells

caveats_and_recommendations.simulation_notice: Initial model baseline trained on synthetic customer transaction simulations.
caveats_and_recommendations.city_calibration: Cross-city transfer requires post-inference scaling factor c_city (1.0 - 1.35x).
